overview_description.description: Tergle offers AI-powered auditing solutions designed to reduce repetitive audit tasks through automation. The company provides a tailored onboarding process that begins with understanding the client’s audit workflow, followed by creating AI solutions customized by engineers and experienced auditors. Tergle supports clients year-round with direct communication channels such as Slack and Zoom. Its platform combines automation with human expertise to streamline audit processes and improve efficiency. Tergle focuses on delivering practical AI tools that adapt to specific auditing needs while maintaining ongoing support.
